name: PuntoPost for WooCommerce
author: puntopost

sections.description:
This plugin integrates PuntoPost shipping into your WooCommerce site, supporting both global shipping methods and custom Shipping Zones.

It includes features for pickup point selection in the checkout, order management and tracking and updated package status.

Introduction

This WooCommerce shipping plugin integrates with PuntoPost to provide pickup shipping capabilities to your WooCommerce store.

This plugin uses external services to handle shipping processes and tracking effectively. You will need a PuntoPost merchant account and its respective credentials to use the plugin.
If you don’t have an account, please visit our website to get more info and request an account: PuntoPost

External Services

This plugin makes use of the following third-party services:

PuntoPost API

  • Purpose: Allows the creation and management of packages in PuntoPost directly through WooCommerce.
  • URL: PuntoPost
  • Privacy Policy: PuntoPost Privacy Policy

OpenStreetMap

  • Purpose: Used to provide map functionalities in the shipping plugin.
  • URL: OpenStreetMap
  • Privacy Policy: OpenStreetMap Privacy

Data Handling and Privacy

When using the plugin, certain data such as user shipping info, tracking numbers and geographical locations may be transmitted to the third-party services mentioned above.
We do not store this data on our servers. Please review the privacy policies of the respective services (linked above) to understand how they manage your data.
